caption:
It's World Kindness Day, and I think that includes being kind to future you.

This is my 20-minute Friday shutdown: four small things that make Monday feel lighter. Swipe through.

What's the kindest thing you do for your future self?

#worldkindnessday #productivity #weeklyreset #fridayroutine #worklifebalance #solopreneur #slowproductivity

✦ AI-generated creator

slides.title: Be kind to your future self

slides.heading: Close your tabs
slides.body: Literally and mentally. Write down what's still open, then shut the laptop.

slides.heading: Leave a note for Monday
slides.body: Three lines: where I stopped, what's next, what I'm waiting on. Monday-me always says thank you.

slides.heading: Clear one small thing
slides.body: The five-minute task you keep moving. Do it now and start next week lighter.

slides.heading: Protect the weekend
slides.body: Notifications off, out-of-office on if you need it. The weekend is not overtime.

slides.title: Save this for Friday afternoon
slides.body: Small kindnesses add up. Especially the ones you give yourself.
